prompt: Assign a model and effort to each task in docs/plans/refunds/plan.md.
one_line: Routing: Opus for complex or UI work, Sonnet for routine code, Haiku for mechanical edits.

checks.name: rename task routed to haiku
checks.cmd: awk '/^## T2/{f=1} f && /^Model:/{print; exit}' docs/plans/refunds/plan.md | grep -qi haiku
